blocks.text: LOG:100–122 DETAILED REVIEW AND DELEGATED APPROVAL — CANONICAL

The Logic process block was reconsidered from first principles under the standing delegated authority. The review compared five genuinely different architectures per root, scored 45 candidates across 360 criterion values, routed 123 English concepts without forced atomization, passed all 18 canonical packet checks, passed all 27 combined Logic entity/process soundness checks, and passed the complete authority regression. All deterministic generated forms remained unchanged.

Approved architecture: LOG:1xx names substrate-neutral formal evaluation processes that determine admissibility under separately typed LOG:0xx constraints. The inward triplet evaluates one reference entity under its applicable internal criterion; the outward triplet applies one specified constraint to one distinct reference target; and the systemic triplet coordinates joint evaluation of multiple participants under one shared formal regime. The third trit changes only completed, active, or nonactualized phase.
LOG:100 — completed internal formal evaluation — Completion of a formal evaluation that determines the admissibility of one reference entity under its applicable internal criterion.
LOG:101 — active internal formal evaluation — An ongoing formal evaluation that is determining the admissibility of one reference entity under its applicable internal criterion.
LOG:102 — nonactualized internal formal evaluation — A nonactualized formal evaluation that would determine the admissibility of one reference entity under its applicable internal criterion.

LOG:110 — completed target constraint application — Completion of a formal evaluation that applies one specified constraint to one distinct reference target and determines that target's admissibility under the constraint.

LOG:111 — active target constraint application — An ongoing formal evaluation that applies one specified constraint to one distinct reference target and is determining that target's admissibility under the constraint.

LOG:112 — nonactualized target constraint application — A nonactualized formal evaluation that would apply one specified constraint to one distinct reference target and determine that target's admissibility under the constraint.
LOG:120 — completed systemic regime evaluation — Completion of a coordinated formal evaluation that determines the joint admissibility of multiple participants under one shared formal regime.
LOG:121 — active systemic regime evaluation — An ongoing coordinated formal evaluation that is determining the joint admissibility of multiple participants under one shared formal regime.

LOG:122 — nonactualized systemic regime evaluation — A nonactualized coordinated formal evaluation that would determine the joint admissibility of multiple participants under one shared formal regime.

Design boundary: these roots do not silently encode the criterion or regime being applied; input or result data; acceptance or rejection; truth or falsity; proof correctness; an implementation algorithm; belief or attention; physical effects; communication; authority; enforcement; applicability, entailment, consistency, computability, scheduling, probability, or time. Inward evaluation requires no distinct external target; target application preserves one specified constraint and one distinct target; systemic evaluation requires one coordinated joint determination under one shared regime. Lexical third-trit 2 remains nonactualized only and is distinct from runtime [2]/num uncertainty.
